sources.summary_zh: 随着英特尔提高数据中心和笔记本电脑 CPU 的产量，AMD 成功超越了它，并不断从其主要竞争对手手中夺取市场份额。

stories.title: Storage unit auction winner finds retro Pentium 4 PC with a see-through, UV-reactive PSU — Y2K time capsule discovered among 100 laptops and hundreds of RAM sticks

sources.title_original: Storage unit auction winner finds retro Pentium 4 PC with a see-through, UV-reactive PSU — Y2K time capsule discovered among 100 laptops and hundreds of RAM sticks
sources.summary: This vintage PC build looks like it came straight out of the 90s with a bold, in-your-face look that make sure you can't mistake it for anything but a gamer's lifeline. What you're looking at is an Apevia X-SuperAlien case with a 500W Apevia PSU.
sources.summary_zh: 这款老式 PC 构建看起来就像是直接从 90 年代诞生的，具有大胆、直面的外观，确保您不会将其误认为是游戏玩家的生命线。您看到的是带有 500W Apevia PSU 的 Apevia X-SuperAlien 机箱。
